premium_about_description: The Kinetic Alphabet is a notation system for prop manipulation choreography. Like musicians reading sheet music, flow artists can write sequences, jump between steps, and share ideas without scrubbing through video. Flow Arts Composer is the digital version of what started as a physical book distributed at flow festivals.
premium_about_support: This is a work-in-progress and is continually growing. Your support plays an essential role in this system's development.
premium_checkout_error: Checkout couldn't start. Please try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.
premium_early_access_message: Flow Arts Composer is in active development. Your feedback shapes the platform.
premium_faq_a_cancel: Yes, absolutely. Cancel your subscription anytime from your account settings. You'll keep access until the end of your billing period.
premium_faq_a_included: Unlimited sequence generation, full access to Compose and Train modules, and priority support. All premium features are clearly marked throughout the app.
premium_faq_a_refund: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If premium isn't right for you, email support@tka.com within 30 days for a full refund.
premium_faq_a_secure: All payments are processed by Stripe, the industry standard for secure online payments. We never see or store your payment information.
premium_faq_q_included: What exactly do I get with premium?
premium_hero_subtitle: Support TKA's development • Built by Austen Cloud
premium_support_note: Your subscription funds server costs, hosting, and ongoing development.
